map.根据成人剂量按体重换算儿童剂量。: Convert an adult dose to a child dose by weight, with an adult-dose ceiling controlled by the maximum factor.
map.儿童剂量按体重换算（按体重比例 + 成人剂量倍数封顶，本页代码口径）：按体重剂量: Paediatric dose scaling by weight (weight ratio + adult-dose multiple ceiling, as coded on this page): weight-based dose = adult dose × (child weight ÷ reference adult weight) (mg); capped dose = min(weight-based dose, adult dose × maximum multiple) (mg; the maximum multiple must be ≥1 and is rejected below 1 so the dose is not compressed to 0); dose ratio = child weight ÷ adult weight × 100 (%). Validation: adult dose, child weight, adult weight and maximum multiple are required guards, other blanks default to 0. Interpretation: no fixed staging; actual dosing must follow medical advice and this result is only a paediatric dosing reference.

map.算法：按体重剂量 = 成人剂量 × (儿童体重 ÷ 成人参考体重)；受限剂量 =: Algorithm: weight-based dose = adult dose × (child weight ÷ reference adult weight); capped dose = min(weight-based dose, adult dose × multiple cap); dose ratio = child weight ÷ adult weight × 100%. All values must be >0.
map.例1（成人 500mg、儿童 20kg、成人参考 70kg、上限 2×）：按体重: Example 1 (adult 500 mg, child 20 kg, reference adult 70 kg, cap 2×): weight-based = 500×20/70 = 142.86 mg, capped = min(142.86, 1000) = 142.86 mg, ratio 28.57%. Example 2 (adult 300 mg, child 15 kg, adult 60 kg, cap 1.5×): weight-based = 300×15/60 = 75.00 mg, capped = min(75, 450) = 75.00 mg, ratio 25.00%.

map.防止单剂超量，取体重估算与\"成人剂量×倍数\"的较小者作为安全上限；仍须以药品: It prevents a single-dose overdose: the smaller of the weight-based estimate and "adult dose × multiple" is taken as the safety cap; the drug label and physician's prescription still govern.
